description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720005
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category.
